footer-note: One JAR: Ktor serves this SvelteKit app and its API on the same port.
home-title: A team board in one JAR
home-lead: This example uses every ktor-svelte feature: a typed client, sessions, a database, uploads, search, paging, themes and two languages.
feature-auth-text: A signed cookie, a rate limited login, and an admin area the server protects.
feature-database-text: Exposed on an embedded H2 database, with Flyway migrations.
feature-uploads-text: Multipart uploads with a progress bar, size limits and safe downloads.
feature-search-text: Search as you type, filters, and cursor based pages.
feature-i-18n-text: The same message files translate the pages and the API errors.
feature-security-text: Security headers, a strict CSP, an origin check and validation on every request.
about-lead: The showcase is a small team board. It exists to exercise ktor-svelte end to end, and it is the target of the browser tests.
about-row-paging: Paging and search as you type
about-row-libraries: Tailwind, DaisyUI, Lucide, images, toasts, i18n
about-row-health: Health endpoint with a database check
about-demo-text: The first start creates ada@example.com as admin and grace@example.com as member. Their passwords come from SHOWCASE_ADMIN_PASSWORD and SHOWCASE_MEMBER_PASSWORD, or are generated and written to the server log.
